app.name.context: App name in the header. It is a brand name.

nav.history.context: Bottom navigation tab: the list of past payments.

home.greeting.context: Greeting at the top of the home screen. {name} is the user's first name.

pay.cta.context: Primary button on the pay screen.

pay.success.context: Message after a payment. {payee} is a person or a shop.

autopay.title.context: Title of the new screen for recurring payments.

autopay.subtitle.context: One line under the title explaining the feature.

autopay.setup_cta.context: Primary button that starts AutoPay setup.

autopay.mandate_info.context: Shown before the user approves a recurring UPI payment. A mandate is the standing instruction the user approves.

autopay.next_debit.context: Shows when money will next be taken. {date} looks like 12 Dec.

autopay.pause_cta.context: Small secondary button that pauses AutoPay.

autopay.cancel_warning.context: Warning before cancelling. Keep the <b> tags around the merchant.

autopay.reminders.one.context: Plural form used when count is 1.

autopay.reminders.other.context: Plural form used for every other count.

autopay.limit_error.context: Inline error under the amount field. {max} looks like 15,000.
